definition: having the skill or power to do something
description: A bright concrete stairwell during a move. On the top landing a young woman in a blue vest top and black joggers, her hair in a long braid, steps down from a stair and stands holding a whole beige two-seat sofa above her head on her own, smiling easily. Below her a young man in a white T-shirt and maroon shorts slips on the steps hugging one big cushion, and at the bottom a young woman in a mustard jumper carries a floor lamp and looks up. A cardboard box and a potted plant stand by the tall window.

en.question: What is the woman in blue doing?
